gui.rstweaks.inventory_interface.filter_: The resources this grid manages, and how many of each to keep on you. Click the marker in a slot's corner to choose whether that entry files away, tops up, both, or neither.
gui.rstweaks.inventory_interface.auto_in: Files surplus items from your inventory into storage while this grid is on you. Never takes what you are holding, your armour, your offhand, or another grid.
gui.rstweaks.inventory_interface.auto_ex: Tops the filtered resources back up to their amount out of storage. Reads the filter list whichever mode it is in, because topping up is a whitelist by nature.
gui.rstweaks.inventory_interface.filter_: Auto-insert only files away the filtered resources, and only what you have beyond their amount.
Auto-insert files away everything except the filtered resources, which it leaves alone entirely. Per-slot insert markers do nothing in this mode.
gui.rstweaks.inventory_interface.choose_: Click your slots to include or exclude
While this is on, clicking a slot in your inventory toggles whether auto-insert may take from it. Excluded slots are shaded red. Turn it off to use your inventory normally again.
gui.rstweaks.inventory_interface.slot_mo: Tops up to the amount only
Files away and tops up, pinning it at the amount
